'''Oden Geiger''' is an [[Engineers|Odyssey Engineer]] based at '''Ankh's Promise''' in the '''Candiaei''' system. He specialises in suit sensors and endurance, night vision, and handheld-weapon optics and recoil control.<ref name="inara-oden">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/34/ Oden Geiger — Engineer], INARA; current access, location, and modification record. Retrieved 12 September 2026.</ref><ref name="fandom-oden">[https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/Oden_Geiger Oden Geiger], Elite Dangerous Wiki; in-game workshop quotation. Retrieved 12 September 2026.</ref>

Oden is reached through [[Terra Velasquez]] and is the terminal Engineer in that referral branch.

Ankh's Promise is a surface Engineer base on Candiaei 9 c, approximately 940 Ls from the system arrival point.<ref name="inara-ankh">[https://inara.cz/elite/station/316548/ Ankh's Promise — Station], INARA; current facility and location record. Retrieved 12 September 2026.</ref>

== Access requirements ==

{| class="wikitable"
! Stage
! Requirement
|-
| Discovery
| Receive a referral from [[Terra Velasquez]] after providing her with '''15 Financial Projections'''.
|-
| Unlock
| Sell a combined total of '''20 Biological Samples, Employee Genetic Data, and Genetic Research''' to bartenders.
|}

The unlock requires twenty qualifying items in total, not twenty of each type. Any combination of the three listed materials may be used. Their acquisition sources and the preceding referral steps belong to [[Unlocking Oden Geiger]].<ref name="inara-oden" /><ref name="inara-terra">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/31/ Terra Velasquez — Engineer], INARA; current referral requirement. Retrieved 12 September 2026.</ref>

{{Field note|INARA reports that station services may not appear immediately after the workshop is unlocked. Relogging should make them available.<ref name="inara-oden" />}}

== Odyssey Engineering ==

Oden installs individual modifications into available suit and handheld-weapon modification slots. His services do not use the Grade 1–5 Engineer-reputation progression, blueprint rolls, Experimental Effects, or Remote Engineering used for ship modules. Equipment grade and modification-slot availability are handled through the wider [[Odyssey Engineering]] system.

== Engineering services ==

{| class="wikitable sortable"
! Modification
! Equipment
! Purpose
|-
| Enhanced Tracking
| Suit
| Increases the range and speed of the suit's basic scan function.
|-
| Improved Battery Capacity
| Suit
| Increases suit battery-energy capacity.
|-
| Night Vision
| Suit
| Adds night-vision capability.
|-
| Scope
| Handheld weapon
| Adds a scope or improves an existing optic.
|-
| Stability
| Handheld weapon
| Reduces weapon recoil.
|}

These five modification types are available once Oden is unlocked, subject to compatible equipment, an open modification slot, and the required Odyssey materials and credits.<ref name="inara-oden" /> Their complete recipes and cross-Engineer availability belong to [[Odyssey Engineer Modifications]].

Night Vision is Oden's distinctive regional service: current records list him as its only provider in the Bubble, with [[Yi Shen]] providing the same modification in Colonia.<ref name="inara-oden" />

== Referral position ==

Oden is the endpoint of the Jude Navarro branch and does not provide a direct referral to another Engineer.

<pre>
Jude Navarro
└── Terra Velasquez
    └── Oden Geiger
</pre>
